Kenji López-Alt Jul 29, 2026 View in app View in app Join our team for a peaceful tofu lunch at Yudofu Sagano in the scenic Arashiyama area of Kyoto. Content & Community Manager Erin here with an invitation for you to enjoy a tofu lunch with us in the next episode of Kenji Eats Japan! Kyoto was our team’s first stop during our visit to Japan in April of this year. Before we left the city, we knew we had to explore tofu cuisine a bit deeper and a donabe filled with broth, simmering away over an open fire gave us the perfect opportunity to dive right in. But first, some background. The Tofu Capital: As the former capital, prior seat of the Emperor, and once-largest city in Japan, Kyoto holds a lot of historic and cultural cachet—especially when it comes to religion. As Zen Buddhism thrived in the city, so did shojin ryori, traditional Buddhist cuisine made without meat or fish.
